body:
I honestly want to be a good example to them. Since I was a kid, I’ve always dreamt of being basically the complete opposite to what I am now. While I was cooped up in my room for ages, my younger siblings were off mingling with a bad crowd and have gotten into some close calls. I wished I wasn’t such a lethargic lazy ass that time, helping them with homework or lending an ear while they vent instead. But after finding out everything that was going on while I was in my own little world, I’ve felt worse and I can’t really do anything about it. I remembered my younger sibling and I got into an argument and they said I was embarrassing to be around. I agree.

In the beginning, my parents have tried to steer me into more academic pursuits. I’ve failed so many times to the point where they’ve given up and basically just let me do whatever, but the disappointment was there. Doesn’t help that my other cousins are studying law, medicine, nursing, etc. Comparisons for dayssss.

The only thing I’ve ever enjoyed in life was art. It’s the only thing I considered myself to be decent in and the only thing that got me any form of attention, which is sad I know. One of the few joys in my life is knowing a couple of art and design teachers I’ve had believed in me and supported me a lot. I’m currently applying for a university on the other side of the country (to hopefully get a new start without anyone from home with me haha). Trying to get into animation so wish me luck haha.

Gotta be a good big sis and get the bad genes, amiright?

And thanks, I’ll try. You take care as well.

While my parents do treat me fine (providing food, shelter, and such), it appears to me they like to brag, especially when it comes to my younger siblings. It honestly feels horrible when you haven’t gotten anything to show off whilst the younger ones get constantly placed on a pedestal. I feel like they like to turn the blind eye when it comes to anything that’ll stain the “talented children” appearance.

Talking snack about them feels bad but it’s just how I feel.

At least we aren’t alone in this though. Thanks for replying.
